limits.name: sourceBytes
limits.assertion: Valid 2MiB UTF-8 comment source; the next byte returns sourceBytes.

limits.name: sourceLineUnits
limits.assertion: 65536 UTF-16 units accepted; 65537 reports sourceLineUnits.

limits.name: expressionUnits
limits.assertion: 8192 expression units accepted; one additional unit rejected.

limits.name: expressionDepth
limits.assertion: Depth 32 accepted; nested depth 33 rejected.

limits.name: astNodes
limits.assertion: Default counter at 100000 and 100001; parser wiring additionally tested with a stricter three-node budget.

limits.name: tintaBlockDepth
limits.assertion: 16 nested blocks accepted and 17 rejected.

limits.name: markdownDepth
limits.assertion: Document/paragraph/container depth accounted for at 64 and 65.

limits.name: declarations
limits.assertion: 512 declarations accepted and 513 rejected.

limits.name: controls
limits.assertion: 128 controls accepted and 129 rejected.

limits.name: identifierUnits
limits.assertion: 64-unit identifier accepted and 65 rejected.

limits.name: textValueUnits
limits.assertion: 65536-unit raw text cell accepted; separate guard proves 65537 rejection because the source line ceiling also binds. Stricter parser tests prove wiring.

limits.name: literalListItems
limits.assertion: 1000 list items accepted and 1001 rejected.

limits.name: tableCount
limits.assertion: 64 tables/views accepted and 65 rejected.

limits.name: tableRows
limits.assertion: 10000 source rows accepted and 10001 rejected.

limits.name: tableColumns
limits.assertion: 64 header columns accepted and 65 rejected.

limits.name: totalCells
limits.assertion: 100000 source cells accepted; an additional source table contributes cell 100001.

limits.name: chartRows
limits.assertion: 2000 prepared rows accepted and 2001 reports chartRows.

limits.name: chartCategories
limits.assertion: 200 categories accepted and 201 reports chartCategories.

limits.name: chartSectors
limits.assertion: 24 sectors accepted and 25 reports chartSectors.

limits.name: chartSeries
limits.assertion: Six series accepted and seven rejected with E_CHART_SERIES.

limits.name: chartMarks
limits.assertion: 6 series times 2000 rows reaches 12000. A separate counter test rejects 12001 independently; stricter integration rejects two marks at a one-mark limit.

limits.name: documentChartMarks
limits.assertion: 32000 prepared marks accepted; exactly mark 32001 rejects the whole revision.

limits.name: chartCount
limits.assertion: 32 syntactic figures accepted and 33 rejected.

limits.name: histogramBinsMin
limits.assertion: Two bins accepted; one rejected. Minimums use minimum-minus-one, not an invented upper-bound error.

limits.name: histogramBinsMax
limits.assertion: Thirty bins accepted and thirty-one rejected.

limits.name: histogramBinsDefault
limits.assertion: Omitting bins produces exactly eight bins. This value is a default, not an upper bound.

limits.name: choiceOptions
limits.assertion: 50 distinct options accepted and 51 rejected.

limits.name: choiceOptionCodePoints
limits.assertion: 120 code points accepted and 121 rejected, including astral characters.

limits.name: labelCodePoints
limits.assertion: 200 code points accepted and 201 rejected, including astral characters.

limits.name: sliderTicks
limits.assertion: Exactly 100000 decimal ticks accepted and 100001 rejected.

limits.name: sliderFractionalDigits
limits.assertion: Six fractional decimal digits accepted and seven rejected.

limits.name: sliderMagnitude
limits.assertion: Endpoint magnitude 1e9 accepted; endpoint 1e9+1 rejected.

limits.name: evaluationOperations
limits.assertion: Exact two-million counter boundary plus integration proving shared view/chart charging and atomic rollback.

limits.name: compileOperations
limits.assertion: Exact five-million counter boundary plus integration proving parsing and binding share one budget.

limits.name: diagnostics
limits.assertion: 100 diagnostics permitted; 101 potential diagnostics yields 99 plus an explicit final limit error.

limits.name: importBytes
limits.assertion: Valid CSV/JSON input at 5MiB accepted; one extra input byte reports importBytes.

limits.name: assetCount
limits.assertion: 100 unique images accepted despite aliases; unique image 101 rejected.

limits.name: assetBytes
limits.assertion: Complete padded PNG at 10MiB accepted; one extra byte rejected.

limits.name: totalAssetBytes
limits.assertion: Exactly 25MiB of unique valid images accepted; one extra unique byte rejected.

limits.name: imagePixels
limits.assertion: Complete one-bit PNG with 20000000 pixels accepted; 20000001 rejected.

limits.name: bundleCompressedBytes
limits.assertion: Valid stored ZIP at 30MiB accepted by the container reader; a 30MiB+1 byte input rejected before reading.

limits.name: bundleExpandedBytes
limits.assertion: Deflated permitted entries totaling 30MiB inflate successfully; an extra expanded byte is rejected. Bundle semantic/asset validation is separate.

limits.name: bundleEntries
limits.assertion: 102 allowed directory entries read; entry 103 rejected before extraction.

limits.name: htmlBytes
limits.assertion: Escaped output fills the 40MiB running budget exactly; the next emitted byte fails across sibling calls.

limits.name: workerWatchdogMs
limits.assertion: No timeout at 2999ms; termination at 3000ms; advancing to 3001ms does not duplicate the event.

limits.name: editorDebounceMs
limits.assertion: No compile at 199ms; one at 200ms; a newer edit cancels the earlier deadline.

limits.name: recoveryDebounceMs
limits.assertion: No recovery write at 999ms; write at 1000ms; newer source cancels the previous pending write.

limits.name: recoveryEntries
limits.assertion: Ten entries retained; an eleventh evicts the oldest inactive entry, never the active one.

limits.name: recoveryTotalBytes
limits.assertion: Exactly 30MiB retained; an additional byte evicts the oldest inactive recovery.
